# 1 Enoch Chapter 92 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Epistle of Enoch

---

**92:1** That-which-was-written by-Enoch the-scribe — even the-complete-wisdom-teaching of-this-instruction, praised-by-all-men and-a-judge of-the-whole-earth — for-all-my-children who-shall-dwell on-the-earth and-for-the-last-generations who-shall-practice-uprightness and-peace.

**92:2** Let-not-your-spirit be-troubled on-account-of-the-times; for-the-Holy-and-Great-One has-appointed days for-all-things.

**92:3** And-the-righteous-one shall-arise from-sleep, shall-arise and-walk in-the-paths-of-righteousness, and-all-his-paths and-his-walk shall-be in-eternal-goodness and-grace.

**92:4** He-will-be-gracious to-the-righteous and-give-him-eternal-uprightness, and-He-will-give-him-power so-that-he-shall-be-endowed-with-goodness and-righteousness. And-he-shall-walk in-eternal-light.

**92:5** And-sin-shall-perish in-darkness for-ever, and-shall-no-more be-seen from-that-day-for-evermore.

---

*EMET notes: Ch. 92 is the epistolary superscription of the Epistle of Enoch — "written by Enoch the scribe" identifies this as a letter for a remote future generation. The contrast of eternal light (v. 4) and darkness (v. 5) frames the ethical dualism of the entire Epistle. 'Holy-and-Great-One' is the standard Enochic divine epithet.*
